sources.excerpt: Dynamite by BSQ Effects | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE BSQ Effects Dynamite LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS COMPRESSOR OVERDRIVE Description The Dynamite DM2 was developed purely and exclusively to help you achieve a more exquisite and refined sound. This pedal is simply the perfect solution to enrich your signal and take it to a professional level, sounding fuller and more elegant. It has a warm and tight compression stage that gives a smooth sustain. It has 4 parameters that allow you an infinite number of precise combinations so you can set it right there... at THAT point, but always being intuitive and easy to use. Unlike common guitar compressor effects with only 2 controls, the Dynamite adds attack and input gain controls, which are essential for shaping the character of the instrument. The overdrive, at the same time, has a transparent, dynamic, and super-sensitive nature that responds to the most subtle nuances of your playing. It's equipped with an active bass and treble EQ with a range of ±18dB, and gain and volume controls, allowing you to use the Dynamite as a full Booster, a light overdrive with just the right bite, or even dive into the realm of distortion. If you're trying to get a more professional sound without having to mortgage your house, the Dynamite DM2 is your best choice.
